experiment: ABLATION - RoBERTa with class-weighted loss (inverse-frequency CrossEntropyLoss)
status: NOT adopted as final model - reported as ablation to show precision/recall trade-off
finding: Weighted loss increased recall on minority/at-risk classes (Suicidal 0.75->0.81, Stress 0.75->0.83, Personality disorder 0.55->0.61) but lowered precision and overall accuracy (82.3%->80.4%) and macro-F1 (0.783->0.766). Classic precision-recall trade-off; the unweighted model was retained as final.
